lines.text: Morphology — See comparison tables.
‘Charodeyka’ most closely resembles ‘Corrida‘ in
petal colouration but differs in having a larger
flower, a longer and thicker stem, more serrated
petals, a stronger perfume and a paler petal colour
{RHS 50A, 50D) than ‘Corrida’ (RHS 46D).
